**Finding: deviation (Article X(b), ¶p0125)** — redline validated and submitted.

**What the clause does:** It binds only us (Licensee), for the Term plus **three years** after expiration/termination, and reaches **any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates** — not just people who worked on our engagement.

**Why it fails the fallback:** Two independent walk-away triggers under NOSOLICIT — duration beyond 24 months, and scope covering all Vendor personnel. The one-way structure also falls short of the mutual fallback.

**What is already acceptable:** The clause defines "Solicit" narrowly (affirmative recruitment aimed at named/identified individuals) and expressly carves out general job advertisements, follow-up with responders, and voluntary inquiries. There is no "no-hire" — it prohibits soliciting someone "to leave" employment only. Those elements meet the playbook and were left untouched.

**The edit (minimal, to fallback):** three year → twelve (12) month; "the Licensee will not" → "neither party will"; "Licensor and/or its Affiliates" → "the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement". Carve-out sentence preserved verbatim.

One related point flagged in the rationale rather than separately redlined: Article XI (¶p0126–p0127) gives Licensor injunctive relief without bond for breach of the non-solicit; that exposure narrows automatically once this edit is accepted, so it is not double-flagged here.
